source: I want a game 3d game that we can run around in unlock new areas rebirth to get more powerfull and we can unlock pets armor fight bosses i want gems that you get from rebirthing that you can use for upgrades I want 15 different areas to unlock through the game currency lunar that each have a different cost for example 1st zone 1x second 1.5x something like that I want different pets for each area that go up in value but also increase your clicks per second and I want the game to be called clicker phyco

image_prompt.text: A central upgrade area where gems earned from rebirthing are spent on power and armour
Walkable circulation chaining the hub out through the fifteen areas in unlock order
Physical barriers on each area that drop away when its lunar cost is paid
Fifteen visually distinct themed areas, each larger or stranger than the last
A boss space inside each area with room to fight in

layout_placement.text: Points in each area where that area boss enters
A spot in each area where that area pet is obtained
A rebirth point where progress is reset in exchange for gems

notes: Called a clicker, but the prompt describes running around and unlocking areas, so stage B lands on a real space rather than P5.
Fifteen themed areas on one shared surface is at the top of what a single top-down frame can hold; if each area is a full environment this wants decomposing.
Rebirth, gems, lunar and pets are progression systems with no layout footprint and no field in this handoff.
Action was loaded as a secondary genre only for the boss spawner, which Simulation cannot express.

open_questions.ask: What should the world look like - the name and the lunar currency hint at space, but you never said. Space, fantasy, or something else?
Are the fifteen areas one continuous world you run between, or separate places you teleport to?

coverage_missing.ask: What is the world made of - space, fantasy, cartoon? Nothing in the prompt says.
How big is one area - a room-sized plot or a whole landscape?
Is there an end state, or does it loop on rebirth forever?

answers.ask: What should the world look like - the name and the lunar currency hint at space, but you never said. Space, fantasy, or something else?
answers.answer: Use a space-themed world to match the Lunar currency, with each area being a different planet or lunar zone.

answers.ask: Are the fifteen areas one continuous world you run between, or separate places you teleport to?
answers.answer: Make the fifteen areas part of one continuous world that players run through and unlock in order.
